text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a walk...
I saw an unusual pairing in an unusual place.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy-P! Also, totally for real!!
Way to goooo☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I'm aware of it.
However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, my mind is completely scrambled...
Calm down, calm down...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—N-No, totally!
Freestyle racing is like, totally god-tier!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It totally clears my head, too~~!
Man, running a race different from usual is super nice, huh☆"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I thought doing something different from usual
might give us a hint to the solution...
choice_data_list: Trying a change of scenery might actually be a good idea

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, but aren't we not racing today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boom-boom-clap, boom-boom-clap♪)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyy~â
The rap battle is about to begiiin~~ââ

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A-A rap battle, you say?!
That's taking things a bit too far...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on! You'll definitely feel better☆
Just spill whatever's on your chest and you're good to go!"

text_block_list.name: DJ
text_block_list.text:
Aaaiiight! Division Fuchu is about to begin!
For the first battle, glasses-wearing horse girl,
come on up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!
Ah, whatever, come what may!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, big sis, why the long face?♪
Stuck on a problem? Drop me an A1, okay?♪
You've got nothin' to lose by just telling me!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
"I-I got injured... and threw a tantrum on the spot!"...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Things are getting tough... situations get worse...!
My thoughts are a mess, my mood takes a dive...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Ran into troubles? Well, that's just life♪"
Hmm...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If it's giving you grief, don't overthink it, okay?♪
Stop fighting yourself and just walk away!♪"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's absurd! To move ahead, I need a decisive blow!
Solving the problem is priority one, so I can run, yo!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Yet the Hayahide Answer is already plain to see.
—You are a 'Runner' who simply yearns to run!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Don't rush your heart, play your winning card♪
Wait for your moment, like a true expert♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A runner only runs... I see...—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...'Just as you said,
I am deeply ashamed for having doubted.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what happens, my feelings won't change.
Continuing to run is my own selfish wish...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: FOOOOOOOO！！

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyyy~â
Nice fight, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Full power, super hyped☆ Demon-level hype★
That was soooo much fun--!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Who knew baring one's emotions
so straightforwardly could feel this good...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Deriving simple answers
by placing constraints on language... that is rap.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Helios-kun.
I'm truly glad you invited me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll boost your mood and bust your worries, 'cause that's my specialty☆
I'm ready anytime, hit me up whenever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, to be blunt, as long as we can hype things up with the mic and the volume, anything goes! But still☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-pi, you're up next! Let's do this☆
Time for a soul-to-soul brawl with me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me.
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of battle it'll be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the cheering crowd, I was brought up onto
the stage... Steeling my resolve, I pondered the words
I would say to her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But looks like it's solved, so we're good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if having fun is the top priority,
it shines upon and warms everyone.
That presence is truly like the sun..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hehe, peace☆
